address: Rua Vinícius de Moraes, 124, A, Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro, 22411-010, Brazil
bio: Located in Ipanema, Didier boasts a modern, vibrant feel with a dining space on two floors bathed in plenty of natural light. Under the baton of chef Didier Labbe (after whom the restaurant takes its name), the cuisine here embraces the essence of French cooking in tandem with local ingredients. The menu comprises a tempting selection of delicacies to satisfy every palate, ranging from classic French dishes and iconic bistro classics such as snails, steak tartare and duck magret to grilled octopus alla putanesca. Those looking for a more traditional flavour will find refuge in the “risotto nero” or the rabbit stew, while those with a more adventurous palate can order the French-style cassoulet stew, which is occasionally on the menu at weekends....
